user_story: As a user, I want to update multiple fields of a task in a single request so that I can edit efficiently.

positive.title: Successfully update all editable fields of a task
steps: Navigate to the task editing interface.
Input valid data into all editable fields of the task.
positive.expected_result: The task is updated successfully with all valid changes reflected.

positive.title: Successfully update only specific fields of a task
steps: Navigate to the task editing interface.
Edit only selected fields with valid data, leaving others unchanged.
positive.expected_result: Only the selected fields are updated with provided changes.

negative.title: Attempt to update a task with invalid data in one field
steps: Navigate to the task editing interface.
Input invalid data (e.g., special characters in a numeric field) in one of the fields.
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the update and displays an error message indicating the invalid input.

negative.title: Attempt to update a task with unauthorized access
steps: While logged in as a user without edit permissions, navigate to the task editing interface.
Attempt to edit and submit changes to the fields.
negative.expected_result: The system prevents the update and displays an error message about insufficient permissions.

edge.title: Update a task with an extremely long input in text fields
steps: Navigate to the task editing interface.
Input extremely long text in a field, such as a description or title.
edge.expected_result: The system handles the long input gracefully, either by accepting the text if within limits or displaying a message if it exceeds allowed length.

edge.title: Submit an update request with all fields left empty
steps: Navigate to the task editing interface.
Clear all fields or do not alter the pre-existing values.
edge.expected_result: The system should either not allow submission or ignore the request as no changes have been made.
